activities.caption: true or false — what an MRI scan actually is
activities.name: miMriJudge

statements.s: MRI exposes the patient to a small dose of ionising radiation.
statements.why: None at all — the signals come from hydrogen nuclei relaxing in a magnetic field.

statements.s: MRI's real hazards are magnetic: ferromagnetic objects become projectiles, and some implants heat or torque.
statements.why: A physical hazard unique to MRI — which is why the screening questions precede every scan.

statements.s: MRI resolves soft tissue no ionising method can, because relaxation is exquisitely sensitive to tissue microstructure.
statements.why: Demyelinating lesions, ligament tears, cord compression — the richest contrast in medicine, bought with minutes, noise and expense.

activities.anchor: making ultrasound the first-line tool for deep-vein thrombosis
activities.caption: one line of the ultrasound note misreads the barriers
activities.name: miUsSpot

config.prompt: A note on ultrasound — one line is wrong. Click it:
lines: Ultrasound sends megahertz sound pulses and times their echoes.
Impedance mismatches at interfaces reflect the sound back.
Doppler mode reads flow velocity from the pitch change of echoes off moving blood.
Ultrasound passes cleanly through gas and calcification, which is why lungs image so well.
Air and bone are the barriers — the reason some organs were long "ultrasound-blind".
config.correction: Ultrasound cannot see through gas or calcification — air and bone are the barriers, which is why the brain and lungs were long "ultrasound-blind" (point-of-care lung techniques have only partially cracked the lung).
config.why: The trade for safety and real time is operator dependence and acoustic barriers.

activities.anchor: Hybrid PET-CT fuses function with anatomy
activities.caption: drag between imaging structure and imaging physiology
activities.name: miGeometryCompare

config.prompt: Two geometries of medical imaging — drag between them:

before.label: the signal comes from outside
before.text: Photons, spins, echoes: the machine interrogates the body and the image maps structure — anatomy, density, relaxation, impedance.

after.label: the signal is injected
after.text: Gamma and positron tracers localise physiology: metabolism, receptor density, proliferation. Malignant tissue's avid glucose trapping is exactly what the metabolic image maps.

config.why: Hybrid scanners fuse the two: the physics of one modality localises what the other characterises.

activities.caption: file each agent by the physics it exploits
activities.name: miContrastBuckets

config.prompt: Contrast agents, engineered by physics — file each:

items.label: iodine's high atomic number — photoelectric absorption lights up vessels
fluorodeoxyglucose trapped by hexokinase in glycolytic cells
PSMA ligands homing to prostate-derived cells

config.why: Different physics, different excretion routes, different renal-risk profiles — "the contrast" is not one thing, and imaging's advances have been as much molecular as instrumental.

activities.anchor: The modality-choice reasoning is deducible from the physics
activities.caption: walk the scan-choice logic
activities.name: miScanBranch

config.root: Three presentations, three first scans — walk the decision logic.

start.text: Suspected acute stroke. Which scan first?

choices.label: Non-contrast CT
choices.feedback: Fast, detects blood, excludes haemorrhage before thrombolysis.

choices.label: Diffusion-weighted MRI
choices.feedback: Decisive later — but the order is wrong.

stroke.text: Then CT angiography or diffusion MRI follows — diffusion shows the infarct within minutes and is decisive for endovascular therapy.

choices.label: Next: the young adult with suspected appendicitis

stroke2.text: Diffusion weighting is the one sequence fast enough to beat CT — after non-contrast CT has excluded haemorrhage.

appy.text: Ultrasound first — no radiation in a young adult; CT if inconclusive. And for major trauma: CT (bone detail, speed, tolerant of metal), switching to MRI when cord pathology is suspected.

config.why: Each choice trades sensitivity, speed, radiation, cost and availability — the guideline flowcharts encode the physics.
